source.title: Monthly new electric car registrations in the United States, 2020-2023
source.notes: The source chart reports monthly BEV and PHEV registrations in thousands. Rows were transcribed from the official downloadable chart data; October 2020 through March 2023.

model: Bass diffusion model fitted to cumulative registrations
limitation: Bass does not represent monthly seasonality, supply constraints, regulation, prices, or causal effects.
